title: Apprentice Crafter
description: Though yet to gain the benefits that storied experience brings, he nevertheless is skilled in constructing battlefield defences, and can pass that knowledge on to others.

title: Master Crafter
description: A veteran of the wars that almost tore the kingdom apart, this man is both a masterful battlefield engineer and a more-than-competent instructor in his area.

title: Shaman
description: Versed in the laws of the southlands, the shaman can find the things which others fail to see.

title: Representationist
description: To communicate between the tribes of the south, one must speak not one, but many languages.

title: Colonel of the Northern Army
description: The Northern Army is yours to command! Each colonel is loyal to whom they have been assigned, vowing never to leave their side!

title: Adept
description: Practice makes perfect, the more that you do it.

title: Architect
description: This man oversees all aspects of construction, from the thought right through to the final form.

title: Artisan
description: More than a mere worker, this one is skilled with his hands in a particular, valuable field.

title: Astronomer
description: See how the Twenty-eight Mansions move through the Four Symbols. There is a pattern - as in all things, I find - like the workings of a machine.

title: Bodyguard
description: If they want you they must go through him first. Good luck.

title: Builder
description: He turns the architect's visions into a reality of wood and clay.

title: Concubine
description: No, she's not my wife. I keep her for… pleasures. It's less complicated than it sounds.

title: Confucian Sage
description: Junzi has many characteristics. Junzi can live with poverty; Junzi does more and speaks less. Junzi disciplines himself.

title: Craftsman
description: In a sea of so many souls, it quite literally pays to specialise.

title: Cryptographer
description: The cipher conceals the details of the plan - and, often, the plan itself - from the enemy at hand.

title: Devious Attendant
description: My lord, if I may approach - I've had a few thoughts that may be of use…

title: Diviner
description: No, it is not guesswork - I have a… sense for these things.

title: Eavesdropper
description: You never know who may be listening, and where they may be hiding.

title: Elite Trainer
description: The best of the best are about to get better.

title: Engineer
description: Levered catapults, repeating crossbows, cloud ladders, rotating arcuballistas - whatever your siege requires, this one can provide.

title: Eunuch
description: He may not be as... 'complete' as other men, but he has many times the guile, believe you me.

title: Farm Manager
description: Standing between the landowner and the peasants, this one ensures the system - and the resultant flow of money - works as expected.

title: Farmer
description: Even the hardest soil can be coaxed into giving life.

title: placeholder
description: placeholder

title: Foreman
description: If the work is to proceed on schedule, the workers must be supervised and directed by another.

title: Forge Master
description: The fruits of the furnace must be carefully managed.

title: Guard
description: Sensible precaution or advertising for criminals? It depends very much on the man chosen.

title: Herdsman
description: This one looks after the livestock until it is needed.

title: Hua Tuo
description: Drink this… trust me, you will feel no pain.

title: Inspector
description: Standards must be upheld.

title: Jade Sculptor
description: The most precious stone rewards the gentlest hand.

title: Labour Recruiter
description: Think of it like this: you will be working directly for the emperor himself.

title: Land Shaper
description: Yes, clear all of it away - I wish to see the lake from here.

title: Law Enforcer
description: In society, one must learn to conform.

title: Legalist Fanatic
description: Standards must not be allowed to slip, for if the state fails, what hope is there for the country?

title: Local Administrator
description: A little local knowledge makes for a more tailored service.

title: Master Craftsman
description: At the top of his profession, this man receives offers of work from far and wide.

title: Mathematician
description: Much more than a student of numbers, this one can see them in his mind's eye and manipulate them instantly.

title: Merchant
description: When the world is for sale, the smart man sees a way to profit from it.

title: Military Expert
description: This grizzled warrior has survived not by running away, but by standing his ground.

title: Military Instructor
description: Right, you ingrates, listen to me if you want to see another dawn!

title: Taoist Monk
description: He lives by alms because the world of men has no value.

title: Officer
description: You heard the man and you know the plan!

title: Overseer
description: Not like that! Stop, now watch me. That's better.

title: Philosopher
description: Life is really simple, but we insist on making it complicated.

title: Prefect
description: The governor can share surplus food, or take it away, with a mere wave of his hand.

title: Professional Instructor
description: You're never too old, or too powerful, to learn something new.

title: Professor
description: What use is all that knowledge if it is not passed on to the coming generation?

title: Provincial Advisor
description: This man knows both the land and its people, and can organise them both.

title: Provincial Auditor
description: You cannot hide from the state.

title: Scholar
description: Before specialisation, learn the basics.

title: Spy Master
description: The gathering of information, and what is done with it afterwards, is an art like any other.

title: Tax Collector
description: It's a dirty job but someone has to do it.

title: Trader
description: What many consider to be beneath them, this man sees as his route to riches.

title: Tycoon
description: Commerce is all.
